sources.sourceText:
🤍🫧 Setlist/Setori 🫧🤍

:_あおさいりうむ: 04:12 "Natsu no Tobira"
:_あおさいりうむ: 09:53 "Bai Bai Fight!"
:_あおさいりうむ: 16:21 "Happy Summer Wedding"
:_あおさいりうむ: 24:39 "Poppin’☆Soda"

4 songs in a row (Average on this case), and good selection.
This is the power of blue seiso being real.

The last one, the original song... It passed many time since the most recent performance (The first live performance is on her 3D debut) and also it surprises how Ramune could hold all lyrics there.

Natsumiya Ramune's "Summer Idol Singing Relay" turn Otsushuwa deshita.
